listing.name: Fallout 2 (Fallout 2 Community Edition)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream calls it fully working; downloadable Windows/Linux/macOS builds. Limits: Upstream calls Fallout2CE fully working; Restoration Project, EtTu and Olympus2207 unsupported. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux/macOS runtime packages; native Intel and Apple-Silicon macOS documented. Windows/Linux selected package CPU architectures unknown in frozen research. Original data: Owned Fallout 2 data; Restoration Project, Et Tu and Olympus 2207 explicitly unsupported. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
